name: hermes-agent-firefox
description: Firefox extension to chat with a self-hosted Nous Research Hermes agent — sidebar/popout chat, multi-session buffering, page context, and interactive approvals.

scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md LICENSE .gitignore ".github/**"
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel=unlisted --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md LICENSE .gitignore ".github/**"
